desc: Ideation and analysis of the problem (Upper Convex Hull + Ternary Search)
Maintain a list of indices representing the upper convex hull of buildings processed so far.
Perform ternary search on the current hull to find the building $j$ that maximizes the intercept $L_i = \frac{H_j X_i - H_i X_j}{X_i - X_j}$.
Add building $i$ to the hull by removing points that violate the upper convex property (slopes must be decreasing).
After processing all buildings, check the global maximum intercept.
Else, print the max intercept with high precision.
